## From starting plots to the CCA

```{r}
read_output('report/sample_selection_counts.csv') |>
  transmute(Site = site, Period = period, Step = step, Label = label, Remaining = remaining,
    Removed = removed, Explanation = explanation) |>
  show_table('sample_selection_counts', caption = '**Counts behind Fig. S3.**')
read_output('report/sample_selection_choices.csv') |>
  transmute(Site = site, Choice = choice, Number = number, Unit = unit, `Plots removed` = plots_removed,
    Explanation = explanation) |>
  show_table('sample_selection_choices', caption = '**Preparation choices that change records but not plot counts.**')
read_output('report/sample_selection_plot_sizes.csv') |>
  show_table('sample_selection_plot_sizes', caption = '**Legacy and resurvey plot areas of the retained plots.**')
read_output('cca_exclusion_summary.csv') |>
  transmute(Era = era, Site = site, Use = use, `Excluded at` = exclusion_period, Reason = reason,
    Excluded = excluded_units) |>
  show_table('cca_exclusions', caption = '**Plots and samples excluded from the CCA, by reason.**')
```

## MORA

The MORA resurvey visited 13 plots in more than one year; the latest adult visit is kept and
seedling records are assigned to the adult visit they belong to before that choice.

```{r}
visits = read_output('MORA_resurvey_visit_audit.csv')
mapping = readr::read_csv(here('data/MORA/resurvey_seedling_visit_mapping.csv'), show_col_types = FALSE)
visits |> filter(stage == 'adult') |>
  group_by(Plot_ID, plot_id) |> filter(n_distinct(assigned_year) > 1L) |>
  summarise(`Adult survey years` = paste(sort(unique(assigned_year)), collapse = '; '),
    `Selected year` = unique(selected_year), `Adults kept` = sum(records[selected]),
    `Adults discarded` = sum(records[!selected]), .groups = 'drop') |>
  rename(`Plot` = Plot_ID, `Plot id` = plot_id) |>
  show_table('mora_repeat_visits', caption = '**MORA plots surveyed in more than one resurvey year.**')
readr::read_csv(here('data/MORA/resurvey_year_source_discrepancies.csv'), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  show_table('mora_year_source_discrepancies', caption = '**MORA plots whose resurvey year differs between sources.**')
```

```{r}
show_figure('report/figures/supplementary/MORA_dynamics.pdf', page = 1:3)
```

**MORA species dynamics between surveys** (three pages: presences, gains and losses, turnover).

## NOCA

```{r}
read_output('NOCA_study_exclusions.csv') |>
  transmute(Plot = plot_id, Reason = exclusion_reason, Source = source_note) |>
  show_table('noca_study_exclusions', caption = '**NOCA plots excluded from the study.**')
read_output('NOCA_tree_correction_audit.csv') |>
  group_by(Action = correction_action, Status = final_status) |>
  summarise(Plots = n(), `Rows added` = sum(corrected_rows_added), `Erroneous rows removed` = sum(erroneous_source_rows_removed), .groups = 'drop') |>
  show_table('noca_tree_corrections', caption = '**2026 NOCA tree corrections applied.**')
```

```{r}
show_figure('report/figures/supplementary/NOCA_cleaning.pdf', page = 1:3)
show_figure('report/figures/supplementary/NOCA_dynamics.pdf', page = 1:3)
```

**NOCA plots remaining after each cleaning step, and NOCA species dynamics between surveys.**

## Records per source

```{r}
lapply(c(MORA = 'MORA_occ.csv', NOCA = 'NOCA_occ.csv', paleo = 'paleo_occ.csv', consolidated = 'occ_consolidated.csv'),
  function(f) { x = read_output(f); tibble(Rows = nrow(x), `Plots or samples` = n_distinct(x$plot_id), Taxa = n_distinct(x$species)) }) |>
  bind_rows(.id = 'Source') |>
  show_table('cleaning_summary', caption = '**Presence records after cleaning.**')
```
